pages.title: Charge
pages.text: Granted to a wearer of the full $(item)Blackhide$() set who has sprinted long enough to reach top speed. It marks that the next impact lands like a boar's.$(br2)Ramming a creature, or hitting it with a fist or weapon, flings it away. It lasts up to 12 seconds and ends on the second ram or on any hit.
